providers.name: TripSit · substance factsheets
providers.description: The upstream factsheet database contains 555 substances; the site and native app expose the 25 entries selected by the combination-chart configuration, including substance classes.
providers.licenseStatement: The repository package declares ISC. This is a recorded declaration, not a separate assessment of every embedded reference.

fields.web: Names, aliases, category tags and search terms.
fields.ios: Names, aliases and search terms; groups come from configuration.
fields.transformation: Local labels and text overlays take precedence. dxm resolves to dextromethorphan; ghb/gbl resolves to ghb.

fields.web: Substance summary and search keywords.
fields.transformation: Local text overlay takes precedence; class descriptions supply separate fallback copy.

fields.web: Dose chart uses formatted_dose and dose_note.
fields.ios: Dose uses formatted_dose; doseNote currently uses properties.dose.
fields.transformation: Dose levels, routes and numeric strings are kept; chart rendering derives visual ranges.

fields.web: Timings, peak chart, after-effects and half-life.
fields.ios: Formatted onset/duration; afterEffects uses properties.after-effects; halfLife uses properties.half-life.
fields.transformation: Web timing charts parse source values. Native and web after-effects inputs differ.

fields.web: Effect labels; properties.effects is extracted into overlays but not the displayed effect list.
fields.transformation: Effect-array overlays are applied by position, then web labels receive icons and title casing.

fields.web: Safety advice.
fields.transformation: Current extraction targets some incorrect top-level field names; not all displayed advice is localized.

fields.web: Reference links and linked PsychonautWiki effect names.
fields.ios: Not exported in the current data pack.
fields.transformation: Inherited links; no independent PsychonautWiki or Erowid fetch.

fields.web: Present in the loaded upstream file; not used as the card's bibliography or interaction source.
fields.transformation: Interaction status, notes and bibliography are read from combos.json instead.

limitations: An upstream revision is not a psy.cards scientific approval.
Individual facts do not carry psy.cards reviewer identities or validation dates.

providers.name: TripSit · interactions
providers.description: Interaction data has 31 matrix keys. The current 25-column interface exposes 300 distinct pairs.

fields.web: Interaction cards, matrix, search status and references.
fields.ios: Matrix status summaries and pair records with notes and sources.
fields.transformation: Read either pair direction, preferring the requested direction's available fields; overlay the translated note. Web and iOS currently order translation keys differently.

fields.web: Legend labels, explanations and emoji.
fields.transformation: Normalize statuses using combogen configuration; local translated definitions take precedence.

limitations: Citations are inherited from TripSit and are not evidence of an independent psy.cards review.
Missing interactions use an unknown fallback; low-risk labels are source categories, not guarantees.

providers.name: TripSit · translations
providers.description: English, French, German and Italian labels are combined with local overlays.

fields.web: Substance and interaction labels; English labels resolve configured columns.
fields.ios: Substance and interaction labels; English labels resolve configured columns.
fields.transformation: Local drug-label augmentations override upstream labels. Web additionally bridges dxm to dextromethorphan.

fields.web: Disclaimer component, with English fallback if absent.
fields.ios: Not imported; native disclaimer comes from local UI strings.
fields.transformation: Rendered as upstream HTML.

fields.web: Loaded in the bundle but not used as current UI copy.
fields.ios: Read with the file but not exported as current UI copy.
fields.transformation: UI chrome is maintained locally.

limitations: The imported files do not record per-string generation providers or psy.cards validation history.

providers.name: TripSit · combogen
providers.description: The chart configuration selects the visible substances and maps interaction categories to presentation tokens.
providers.licenseStatement: No license declaration was found in the imported repository's package metadata.

fields.web: Column selection and original within-group order.
fields.transformation: Local category overrides and group ordering are applied.

fields.web: Status normalization, semantic status keys and icons.
fields.transformation: Font Awesome identifiers are mapped to the app's icon identifiers; the chart generator itself is not run.

limitations: Configuration ordering is editorial presentation, not a prevalence or evidence ranking.

providers.name: Wikipedia · combination names
providers.description: A saved import of the List of drug combinations supplies slang, intoxication names and terms for search, alongside separately identified manual entries.
providers.licenseStatement: The saved import records CC BY-SA 4.0; the revision and article history provide attribution to Wikipedia contributors.

fields.path: entriesById.*: slang, intoxicationNames, comment, sourceSlots, tripSitKeys, pairKeys, combinationKey
fields.web: Slang labels and search aliases/keywords.
fields.ios: Intended for search terms, but the current generator does not read entriesById correctly.
fields.transformation: Wiki markup is cleaned, terms are mapped to TripSit identifiers, and combinations produce pair indexes.

fields.web: Search term indexes and pair-name lookup.
fields.transformation: Cards restrict names to two-key/single-pair entries; search also indexes broad class and multi-pair mappings.

fields.web: Import provenance and mapping audit; not a scientific score.
fields.transformation: Manual mappings and exclusions are in the importer or generated seed; row-based IDs currently move when source rows move.

limitations: Wikipedia enrichment never replaces TripSit interaction status, note or sources.
The retained snapshot has 47 entries (including manual curation) and 13 unresolved source terms.
A revision is recorded, but the original raw wikitext snapshot and its checksum are not retained; the current importer is not fully reproducible.

providers.name: psy.cards · language and editorial content
providers.role: Local overlays, interface copy and terminology
providers.description: Local English source overlays, translated content, class descriptions and UI copy, with human-readable terminology guidance.
providers.licenseStatement: No separate license is asserted here for local editorial content.

fields.web: Interface labels, descriptions and local editorial summaries.
fields.transformation: Web replaces named placeholders; iOS currently converts them to unnumbered %@ placeholders.

fields.web: Label augmentation.
fields.transformation: Overrides upstream labels.

fields.web: Translated notes, definitions and class text.
fields.transformation: text replaces source copy. _source is retained for comparison but runtime does not check drift.

fields.path: content/{locale}/drugs/*.json: pretty_name, properties.summary, properties.effects, dose_note, formatted_effects[].{_source,text}
fields.web: Factsheet overlays; additional existing overlay keys are recursively applied.
fields.ios: Overlays are applied before data-pack projection.
fields.transformation: Source identity is the substance key/file; array elements use positional identity. Extractor also attempts top-level avoid/test_kits, which do not match the rendered upstream fields.

fields.web: Contributor/translation guidance, not loaded by the site.
fields.transformation: The separate OpenAI provider reads this guidance; the currently wired fill command uses MyMemory directly.

limitations: No structured per-string generation/provider/reviewer history exists. The current fill script cannot establish who produced existing translations.
Translation coverage is not scientific or language validation. The current i18n:check command reads the wrong directory and can falsely pass.
Class descriptions and local summaries need their own evidence and scientific review; they are not automatically upstream-validated.

providers.name: psy.cards · molecular structures
providers.description: Locally maintained SMILES strings and compound labels, including representative structures for some classes.
providers.licenseStatement: Original per-entry provenance is not recorded in this file.

fields.web: Molecular diagrams and structure data endpoint.
fields.ios: Molecule metadata and generated image assets.
fields.transformation: SmilesDrawer renders the strings; representative marks a class illustration rather than every member's structure.

limitations: The local Git date records a repository change, not chemical validation or retrieval from a scientific provider.
Do not infer an unrecorded PubChem or other external import.

providers.name: PsychonautWiki · inherited effect links
providers.description: Effect names and URLs arrive through TripSit's pweffects field; there is no independent PsychonautWiki importer.

fields.web: Expandable linked effect list.
fields.transformation: Inherited through TripSit; the upstream page revisions are not recorded.

limitations: TripSit's snapshot date is not a PsychonautWiki page revision date.
providers.licenseStatement: No separate license statement recorded here.

providers.name: Research citations and reference sites
providers.description: Journal articles, books, Erowid and other references are linked from TripSit records. psy.cards does not independently synchronize those publications.

fields.web: Pair bibliographies and factsheet links.
fields.transformation: Citation strings are preserved. Publication dates in citation text are not verification dates.

limitations: Independent retrieval, revisions and psy.cards assessment of the cited works are not recorded. Individual links remain on their corresponding cards.
providers.licenseStatement: No separate license statement recorded here.

providers.name: The Drugs Wheel
providers.description: Credited by the site for its classification approach. Groups, overrides and summaries are held in local code and UI copy; no Drugs Wheel dataset is fetched.
limitations: No external dataset revision or retrieval date is recorded.
providers.licenseStatement: No separate license statement recorded here.

providers.name: Drugwatch
providers.description: Appears in the site's acknowledgements. The current pipeline contains no separate Drugwatch data import.
limitations: An acknowledgement does not establish a data feed or scientific endorsement.
providers.licenseStatement: No separate license statement recorded here.

providers.name: SmilesDrawer
providers.description: Draws molecular diagrams from local SMILES strings. This is a software credit, not the provider of the chemical structures.
limitations: Dependency versions are pinned by pnpm-lock.yaml; a software release is not a scientific data revision.
providers.licenseStatement: No separate license statement recorded here.
